model_rules_declared.band: mean +/- 1.2816 * sd_used (an 80% band under a normal model)
model_rules_declared.probability: normal model on (our projection, sd_used); the anchor is the player's own season average as published by this site, NOT a sportsbook line
model_rules_declared.small_sample: with n = 3-4 the SD itself is uncertain by about SD/sqrt(2(n-1)) - printed per row as sd_uncertainty; nothing here is a claim of statistical significance

_meta.what_this_changes: F2 and Q3 asked for a measured dispersion figure because none existed. Ten players now have one; the other 78 prop rows are unchanged and still publish no probability.
